title: jstack-cli doctor --json
description: One finding per install check, in the order doctor runs them.

passed.description: True when no finding has status fail.

id.description: The check: pstack, plugin, cli, jstack (a jstack on PATH that is not jstack-cli), config, mode, repo:<repo>, check:<repo>, or check when the config has no repos.

details.description: Lines a failed jstack-cli check printed.

run.description: True when doctor --fix may run the command. False for advice and for commands of a harness jstack cannot drive.
